definitions: To move slowly and carefully, especially in order to avoid being heard or noticed.
To move with the body close to the ground.
To grow along the ground or a surface, or up a wall.
To feel as if insects are crawling on one's skin.
To happen or develop very slowly or imperceptibly.
examples: I crept out of the room.
The cat crept through the long grass.
Ivy creeps up the side of the house.
The thought of it makes my skin creep.
